verse.unicode: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥

transliteration.english: man re prabh kee saran bichaaro ||

en.bdb: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

verse.unicode: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jeh simarat ganakaa see udharee taa ko jas ur dhaaro ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: aTal bhio dhraooa jaa kai simaran ar nirabhai padh paiaa ||

en.bdb: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

verse.unicode: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: dhukh harataa ieh bidh ko suaamee tai kaahe bisaraiaa ||1||

en.bdb: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

verse.unicode: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥

transliteration.english: jab hee saran gahee kirapaa nidh gaj garaeh te chhooTaa ||

en.bdb: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

verse.unicode: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: mahamaa naam kahaa lau baranau raam kahat ba(n)dhan teh tooTaa ||2||

en.bdb: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: ajaamal paapee jag jaane nimakh maeh nisataaraa ||

en.bdb: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥

transliteration.english: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman tai bhee utareh paaraa ||3||4||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||
